headline: Biomolecular language models are paired with structure and stress-tested for validity and calibration
label: Protein Model Evaluation And Calibration
summary: Recent preprints probe where protein and molecular models fail, from relabeling-sensitive contacts to delta-level perturbation metrics, while adding calibration and structure.
synthesis: The common thread is pretrained protein, mRNA and molecular representations applied to variant, binding, interaction and developability prediction, increasingly paired with structural, thermodynamic or evolutionary information. Examples include EvoPhi-DDG combined with JanusDDG for thermodynamically consistent stability, MADM for multi-assay antibody developability, ProtLink for interaction prediction, and BioLM-Score for protein-ligand scoring. What is new is the emphasis on diagnosing limits and reliability. Language-model contact maps collapse under bijective amino-acid relabeling, global Pearson inflates perturbation-response performance relative to delta Pearson, and global pooling of mRNA embeddings is questioned in favor of region-aware readouts. ProtCOVER adds family-level conformal calibration for unseen protein families, and MIRAGE-DTA arbitrates conflicting evidence.
